change_summary: Alert 241 records a retraction whose notice DOI is 10.9999/fake.2020.024, detected on 2026-10-01, but the tracked paper's own DOI is 10.9999/fake.2020.024, and the Crossref title recorded for that DOI is the paper's own title, not a retraction notice title. No separate retraction notice text was provided, the current copy has no retraction watermark or banner, and its content does not differ from the stored paper. The paper went online on 3 April 2020, which does not match the alert's 2026 detection date, and the current copy still reports the trial's main finding: LGG reduced antibiotic-associated diarrhoea (11.5% vs 21.2%). The retraction alert is not shown to be about a real change to this paper, so nothing here shows its findings are affected.
